question: What relation between body and self is compared to the relation between yantra and deity?
premises: Body and self are said to be non-different.
Yantra and deity are compared to them.
The comparison is stated with as and so.
inference: The yantra and deity are non-different just as body and self are non-different.
uncertainties: Whether this is ontological identity or ritual correspondence is not specified.
plain_english: Just as body and self are non-different, so too are yantra and deity.
